import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter1 = ax1.scatter(data['Sleep Duration'], data['Quality of Sleep'], 
                       c=data['Stress Level'], cmap='YlOrRd', s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar1 = plt.colorbar(scatter1, ax=ax1)
cbar1.set_label('Stress Level', fontsize=9)

# 2. Physical Activity Level by Occupation
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
occupation_activity = data.groupby('Occupation')['Physical Activity Level'].mean().sort_values()
ax2.barh(range(len(occupation_activity)), occupation_activity.values, color=colors[1])
ax2.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_activity)))
ax2.set_yticklabels(occupation_activity.index, fontsize=9)
ax2.set_xlabel('Avg Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Physical Activity by Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 3. BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = data['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors[:len(bmi_counts)], startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
sleep_disorder_counts = data['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
bars = ax4.bar(range(len(sleep_disorder_counts)), sleep_disorder_counts.values, 
               color=colors[3], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(sleep_disorder_counts)))
ax4.set_xticklabels(sleep_disorder_counts.index, fontsize=9, rotation=15, ha='right')
ax4.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(sleep_disorder_counts.values):
    ax4.text(i, v + 0.05, str(v), ha='center', va='bottom', fontweight='bold')

# 5. Daily Steps vs Heart Rate
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax5.scatter(data['Daily Steps'], data['Heart Rate'], 
           c=data['Age'], cmap='viridis', s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Daily Steps vs Heart Rate', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar5 = plt.colorbar(ax5.collections[0], ax=ax5)
cbar5.set_label('Age', fontsize=9)

# 6. Stress Level Distribution by Gender
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
stress_by_gender = data.groupby('Gender')['Stress Level'].mean()
bars = ax6.bar(stress_by_gender.index, stress_by_gender.values, 
               color=[colors[0], colors[2]], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax6.set_ylabel('Avg Stress Level', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Average Stress Level by Gender', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylim(0, max(stress_by_gender.values) * 1.2)
for i, v in enumerate(stress_by_gender.values):
    ax6.text(i, v + 0.1, f'{v:.1f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontweight='bold')

# 7. Correlation Heatmap
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = data[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0,
            square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, ax=ax7)
ax7.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Key Variables', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.tick_params(labelsize=9)

# 8. Age Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax8.hist(data['Age'], bins=10, color=colors[5], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax8.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.axvline(data['Age'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: {data["Age"].mean():.1f}')
ax8.legend()

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset Analysis', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
